title: Flankers-NEAR
description: EEG dataset from a flanker paradigm with visually presented four-letter words and pseudowords. Targets appeared with no flankers, identical flankers, or different flankers, and participants judged each item as a real word or pseudoword using a game controller. Data were collected at the NeuroCognition Laboratory in San Diego across 270 trials per participant.
methods_description: Participants sat in a darkened, sound-attenuated room and viewed a monitor while responding with a game controller. Stimuli were 90 real words and 90 pseudowords, each shown once in three flanker conditions (no flanker, identical, different), giving 270 trials. Each trial had a 1000 ms purple fixation cross, a 500 ms white fixation cross, a 150 ms stimulus, and then a blank screen until response.
